definitions.scoring: native estimate measurement stamps; no resampling repeated low-frequency NDT as raw matches
definitions.estimate: A: local base pose; B: held NDT map->odom composed with local base; C: held mocap correction composed with local base
definitions.alignment: one fixed SE(2) from 3s stationary window ending .5s before motion; window excluded; no trajectory refit or scale
definitions.endpoint: norm of mean ex/ey during 2 to 5 seconds after stop command; includes braking overshoot
definitions.pose_jump: maximum consecutive estimate displacement at <=.25s over entire scoring interval, even when reference is missing; includes real motion
definitions.error_jump: maximum consecutive change of estimate-reference error, compensating actual reference movement
definitions.distance_axis: mocap planar base origin displacement from start; sampled path distance also provided
